description: This file defines the 'Column' class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet namespace. It provides methods for handling spreadsheet columns, including retrieving column indices, iterating over cells or rows within a column, checking if a column is empty, and accessing the parent worksheet.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a column in a spreadsheet worksheet, providing methods for accessing and iterating over cells within that column.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Column object with a parent Worksheet and a column index (e.g., 'A').

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that nullifies the reference to the parent worksheet.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column index as a string, e.g., 'A'.

methods.name: getCellIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for iterating over cells in the column between startRow and endRow.

methods.name: getRowIterator
methods.description: Synonym for getCellIterator(), returns an iterator over cells in the column.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Determines if the column contains no cells based on specified flags, starting and ending row parameters.
